changes.change: Documentation brought towards pubkit's Rust crate standard by its rust-crate-quality agent: exact `# Errors` sections and docs for every item other modules use, `// covers:` comments on the unit tests, a README covering commands, why pubrel, related tools, versioning and its versioned interface, MSRV and security, and a new SECURITY.md.
pubrel is licensed under Apache-2.0, as publet is, instead of MIT, and the licence text ships as LICENSE.

`pubrel --help` (and `-h`, `help`) prints the usage to stdout and succeeds; it failed as an unknown command, with the usage on stderr. The usage now lists `summary` among the commands --package applies to, and the --package=NAME and version spellings.

pubrel depends on publet-core 0.1.2 from crates.io instead of a git tag, and its manifest carries crates.io metadata and an include list, so it can be published there. Scenarios cover init, --version and --help.

comment: Changes not yet released. One row per change: category changed or removed (a published interface changed: major), added (a feature: minor), or fixed or security (patch). `pubrel add` appends one; `pubrel summary` sets the release's summary; `pubrel prepare` moves them into the package publet.
